title: Incorrect package name in version lookup
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing incorrect version reporting and potential failures when the attribute is accessed.
note: Real: the merged PR looks up the version of `werkzeug`, not `jinja2`. Its maintainers fixed it two minutes after it merged.

title: Subprocess call without timeout
detail: The temporary file pager invokes the pager via subprocess.call without specifying a timeout or handling potential hangs, which could block the caller indefinitely if the pager process stalls or never exits.
note: A pager runs until the user quits it, so a timeout would cut it off; nothing is wrong.
